scientific_integrity: The theorem is proved by a finite-descent argument, while included computations only check finite cases and an exact witness. The self-review is not independent validation, and earlier unindexed proofs remain possible.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the polynomial \(t^{2}-t+1\) and squarefree reciprocal-gcd inputs; no claim about squared-prime cycles, general prime powers, or infinitude. The explicit 3-prime example is not claimed to be newly minimal.
title: No reciprocal sixth-cyclotomic divisibility and a sharp squarefree gcd-sum support bound
